message.content: {"rules":["The closure `f` must perform only async-signal-safe operations when run in the child process after `fork` and before `exec`.","The closure `f` must not violate library invariants through invalid use of resources duplicated by `fork`, such as file descriptors and memory-mapped regions.","Panicking in `f` is safe only if all format arguments for the panic message can be safely formatted, even though `Command` calls `std::panic::always_abort` before invoking `f`."]}
